What if you could stop time for everyone except you?
You snap your fingers, and the whole world freezes.
If time stops, air molecules stop too. Every breath feels like pushing against concrete.
Light stops moving, so the world goes pitch black.
You'd be blind, deaf, and suffocating inside a world of frozen air.
Your superpower is actually a coffin.
So next time you wish you could stop time... maybe just ask for five more minutes of sleep.
